caption: Hardhat 3 reads secrets through configVariable from an encrypted keystore, never from a plaintext .env file that's easy to commit by accident.
m.contract deploys in dependency order — both tokens, then the pool. Ignition tracks the run so a failed deploy can resume.

code:
hardhat keystore set SEPOLIA_RPC_URL
hardhat keystore set SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY
hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/SimplePoolDeployment.ts --network sepolia
npx hardhat verify --network sepolia <POOL_ADDRESS> <TOKEN_A> <TOKEN_B>
